link_types.name: portal_quote_to_sales_order_by_converted_id
link_types.description: Link contract portal-quote-to-sales-order-by-converted-id (json_path): A Portal quote was converted to this sales order: Portal stamps the quote's custom_fields.convertedSalesOrderId in the conversion transaction. Only an ACCEPTED quote converted in Portal carries it; a quote agreed by email or in FM/Sage never does.

evidence.note: link contract portal-quote-to-sales-order-by-converted-id: A Portal quote was converted to this sales order: Portal stamps the quote's custom_fields.convertedSalesOrderId in the conversion transaction. Only an ACCEPTED quote converted in Portal carries it; a quote agreed by email or in FM/Sage never does.

link_types.name: portal_sales_order_to_quote_by_source_id
link_types.description: Link contract portal-sales-order-to-quote-by-source-id (json_path): A Portal sales order was created from this quote: Portal stamps the order's custom_fields.sourceQuoteId when it converts an ACCEPTED quote. An order entered in FM or by hand has no source quote recorded; customer and amount agreement is not a link.

evidence.note: link contract portal-sales-order-to-quote-by-source-id: A Portal sales order was created from this quote: Portal stamps the order's custom_fields.sourceQuoteId when it converts an ACCEPTED quote. An order entered in FM or by hand has no source quote recorded; customer and amount agreement is not a link.

link_types.name: portal_so_to_fm_order_by_fmid
link_types.description: Link contract portal-so-to-fm-order-by-fmid (json_path): A Portal sales order is bridged to this FM order_entry through custom_fields.fmId, the link Portal itself resolves by. The order number is not a link: Portal rewrites order_number to the BC document No. after drain. Portal's bridge may have first chosen an existing unlinked SO by PO/ERP text (findUnlinkedPortalSo) before stamping fmId; the pack treats the stamped fmId as a source-asserted link (03-PORTAL section 9), and so does this contract.

evidence.note: link contract portal-so-to-fm-order-by-fmid: A Portal sales order is bridged to this FM order_entry through custom_fields.fmId, the link Portal itself resolves by.
